name: DCA Terran Treats (Avengers Campus) "Cosmic Cream Orb" Cream Puff & Sweet Spiral Churro
brandOrRestaurant: Terran Treats Cart (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Airy choux pastry cream puff filled with whipped cheesecake mousse; low in fiber when shared with a lactase enzyme (verify the seasonal spiral churro flavor is not citrus/chili).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a lactase tablet for the whipped cheesecake filling and scrape off any seeded raspberry sauce.
watchOuts: Contains cream cheese/whipped dairy; check seasonal spiral churro flavors for lime/lemon or chili powder
